priority_1.workout_details: 15-minute warm-up in Zone 2, ending with 3x 30-second high-cadence spin-ups. Main set: 5x 3-minute intervals at 285 - 310 Watts (Target: 110-120% of your 258W FTP), maintaining a cadence of 95-100 RPM. Rest: 3 minutes of recovery spin at <130 Watts between each interval. Cool-down: 10 minutes easy spinning.
priority_1.reason: This session directly targets the 5-minute power goal. Because your legs are highly fresh from a 2-day rest, you are in the perfect physical state to hit the high wattage requirements of VO2max intervals without premature failure.

priority_2.workout_details: 10-minute progressive warm-up jog followed by dynamic drills. Main set: 4x 1000m intervals at goal 5km pace (Target HR range: 175-184 bpm), focusing on clean running mechanics and a high stride rate. Recovery: 2 minutes of walking recovery between efforts. Cool-down: 10 minutes of easy jogging.
priority_2.reason: This is a key running quality session designed to drive aerobic power and anaerobic threshold adaptations. This alternative ensures that we continue to systematically build your 5km speed when freshness is high.

priority_3.session_title: Anterior-Posterior Chain Strength & Upper Body Aesthetics
priority_3.workout_details: 1) Barbell Back Squat: 4 sets x 5 reps @ 85kg. 2) Barbell Overhead Press: 3 sets x 8 reps @ 45kg. 3) Heavy Sandbag Carries: 3 sets x 50 meters (70kg sandbag). 4) Supersetted Auxiliary Work: Barbell Bicep Curls (3 sets x 10 reps) and Hanging Leg Raises (3 sets x 15 reps).
priority_3.reason: If you are experiencing any unmeasured neural fatigue and prefer to stay off the cardiovascular system today, this strength option builds sport-specific torque to support cycling power and running efficiency while targeting your upper body aesthetic goals.
